full_text: Republic of the Philippines DEPARTMENT OF THE INTERIOR AND LOCAL GOVERNMENT A. Francisco Gold Condominium II Bldg, EDSA corner Mapagmahal St., Diliman, Quezon City LEGAL SERVICE MR. LAMBERTO B. GABINETE 4054 Villa Josefina Barangay Calios Santa Cruz, Laguna Dear Mr. Gabinete: 27 May 2010 OPINION NO. 62 s. 2010 This concerns your letter-query seeking the opinion of this Department on issues relative to the declaration of permanent vacancy in the office of the Punong Barangay and claim for honorarium. In response thereto, please be informed that we have already substantially answered the same issues in DILG Opinion No. 22, Series 2010 dated March 10, 2010 and DILG Opinion No. 24 Series of 2004 dated F_ebruary 17, 2004 that the Local Government Code did not empower any agency or official of the government to declare permanent or temporary vacancy due to the illness of the incumbent. These are adjudicatory matters which only our courts of justice are empowered to declare. To date, we find no cogent reason to deviate from or set aside the said Opinion. For your ready reference, we are enclosing herewith a photocopy of the above-mentioned DILG Opinions. We hope we have enlightened you on the matter. Very truly yours, By Authority of the Secretary: . JES B. DO Di ctor 111 fs/28/rb#27
